title: #56 Experiential Learning
prompt: Some people point that experiential learning (i.e. learning by doing it) can work well in formal education. However, others think a traditional form of teaching is the best. Do you think experiential learning can work well in high schools or colleges?

promptSegments.text: Some people point that experiential learning (i.e.
learning by doing it) can work well in formal education.
However, others think a traditional form of teaching is the best.
Do you think experiential learning can work well in high schools or colleges?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Experiential learning helps students understand concepts better through hands-on activities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Experiential learning helps students understand concepts better through hands-on activities.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Group activities help students build social skills by encouraging them to talk with others.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Group activities help students build social skills by encouraging them to talk with others.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Traditional teaching methods are superior because students require time to absorb facts and ideas from daily life, such as reading history books to learn dates and names.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traditional teaching methods are superior because students require time to absorb facts and ideas from daily life, such as reading history books to learn dates and names.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, a structured classroom setting is optimal because it provides clear rules and set lessons, allowing students to learn the correct way to write sentences.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, a structured classroom setting is optimal because it provides clear rules and set lessons, allowing students to learn the correct way to write sentences.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Experiential learning helps students gain practical skills that they need for their future jobs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Experiential learning helps students gain practical skills that they need for their future jobs.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Experiential learning also improves students' ability to think critically about subjects.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Experiential learning also improves students' ability to think critically about subjects.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Traditional classroom settings offer a structured way to teach important subjects, allowing students to receive clear information from teachers and books, which builds a strong base of knowledge.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traditional classroom settings offer a structured way to teach important subjects, allowing students to receive clear information from teachers and books, which builds a strong base of knowledge.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Traditional teaching methods give necessary structure for students to learn complex ideas, helping them focus on core concepts and build understanding step by step.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traditional teaching methods give necessary structure for students to learn complex ideas, helping them focus on core concepts and build understanding step by step.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
